understood.why: Grades 1: 9, 2: 9, 3: 10, 4: 10. I got the core of the game right: I am the Will of a newly woken Earth Mind in 2040, asking whether we are alone. I named Prometheus as the open question and gave a reasoned next move. I lost a point on 1 because I never picked up that finding other minds is both our greatest chance and our gravest danger, or that it is all built on real data. I wrote only 'the game is about whether we're alone.' I lost a point on 2 because I described Mind as something that 'answers questions, gives advice and drafts messages' and missed that it never acts on its own, and I did not mention that Scan sorts leads into ones that need us and quiet ones.
